PROHIBITED PRACTICES

• Classroom / workplace emotion recognition

(Annex III, Category 3 & 4)

1. Institutional Scope & Azure / SharePoint Infrastructure Boundaries  
This Acceptable Use Policy (AUP v4.0) governs all artificial intelligence systems deployed across Educore Services—including central administration, Teacher Academies, and campuses (Sentinel Kabitaka, Trident College, Frontier). All AI models, copilots, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) agents operate on enterprise Azure Cloud Infrastructure. Data access is grounded in Microsoft SharePoint document libraries and enforced through Microsoft Purview Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Information Barrier policies, and Sensitivity Labels.</source>

• Label: 'Restricted - IT Infrastructure'
• Purview Information Barriers enforce siloed access
• Real-time alert logging  
4. Data Protection, Purview DLP & Automated Stop Conditions  
1. Zero Public Retraining: All Azure OpenAI Service and M365 Copilot instances operate under Microsoft Enterprise Data Protection agreements. Student data, essays, and administrative inputs are never used to retrain public models.
2. Purview Automated DLP Rules: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention filters scan prompts and documents in real time. Any attempt to input unencrypted Zambian NRC numbers, credit card details, or student health records triggers an immediate system block.
3. Socratic Stop Conditions: Student-facing Azure AI agents automatically block prompts requesting full assignment solutions or unassisted essay generation, nudging students back to step-by-step problem-solving.</source>
